# CMP 128 Honors Option GUI Project
Assist this course's students with introductory Java, arrays/ArrayLists, loops, decisions, methods, and JavaFX events.
Follow the professor's Honors project requirements. Copilot completion is permitted as a development aid; students must review, understand, and explain submitted code and document meaningful assistance.
Use small examples and comments. Do not write the entire project or fabricate test evidence.
Keep HonorsLauncher.java as supplied infrastructure. Do not hardcode a student class name into configuration or use the active editor filename as a launch target.
The setup uses the JavaFX SDK directly, not Maven. Keep Java files in the project root without package declarations. Avoid FXML and advanced frameworks unless the professor approves.
Do not claim the GUI works until it has been tested on the student's computer.
